Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from this enticing contest but the Women's Asia cup drama continues as we have a double header coming your way on Saturday, 8th October! Sri Lanka Women take on Malaysia Women in the first game at 8.30 am IST (3.00 am GMT) and India Women take on Bangladesh Women at 1.00 pm IST (7.30 am GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Nida Dar is the Player of the Match. She says that it was a slow start for them but Bismah Maroof told her that they need a good partnership and they did it. Adds that she knew her strong areas and they went with the plan. Further says that in the last 4 overs it didn't go well and they need to work on it and they are happy to win the game.

Bismah Maroof the captain of Pakistan Women says that it was an important game for them and they executed their plans well this time. Adds that Nida Dar batted and bowled really well. She played a crucial knock that helped them get to a good total. Further says that they didn't assess the conditions really well in their previous game against Thailand but in this game, they executed their plans well.

Harmanpreet Kaur the skipper of India Women says it went wrong in the middle as they were trying to give chances to the new batters. Adds that in the middle overs they fumbled a bit and played too many dot balls which cost them in the end. Further says that it was a great opportunity for the new batters to execute themselves but they failed to do it. Finishes by saying that they should not repeat the mistakes they have made in this game.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the match, Pakistan Women elected to bat first after winning the toss. They found themselves in trouble at the start but the partnership of 76 runs between Nida Dar and Bismah Maroof took them to a respectable total of 137. In reply, India Women never got going and they succumbed under pressure and ended up losing by 13 runs.

India Women got off to a positive start with Sabbhineni Meghana playing some fine strokes. However, she could not carry on and perished. Jemimah Rodrigues followed her soon and India Women were struggling at 29 for 2 at the end of the Powerplay! Pakistan Women never let the momentum get away from them and they kept grabbing wickets at regular intervals to keep India Women under the pump. None of the batters from India found any sort of rhythm, and as the pressure kept piling up India lost wickets. Richa Ghosh came in and struck some lusty blows towards the end and gave India Women a slight glimmer of hope, but she too failed to stick around till the end. For Pakistan Women it was Nashra Sandhu who grabbed three wickets, while Sadia Iqbal and Nida Dar claimed two wickets each. The pendulum kept swinging, but it finally settled on Pakistan's side.

What a thrilling contest we have witnessed here! An India-Pakistan game never fails to disappoint! Drama, excitement, and entertainment this game had it all. In the end, it was Pakistan Women who held their nerve and defeated arch-rivals India Women. A historic win here as this is just the third time they have defeated India in T20I! After an embarrassing defeat against Thailand 24 hours back, Pakistan Women have turned things around and have beaten the tournament favorites, India.

OUT! TIMBER! Pakistan Women have registered a big win in this tournament. A yorker and on middle, Rajeshwari Gayakwad looks to loft it but misses and the ball rattles the stumps. Pakistan Women jump in joy. India Women are wrapped up for 124 and Pakistan Women win by 13 runs!
Full toss and on off, Singh flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one. 14 needed from 3 now!
Slightly shorter and on off, Rajeshwari Gayakwad looks to pull it but gets a top edge. The ball lands safely at mid off. They cross.
Wide! Wayward and outside off, Rajeshwari Gayakwad lets it go.
Fuller and on middle, Renuka Singh eases it to mid-wicket for one.
Tosses it up full on the off, Gayakwad punches it through the off side. Dot again. 18 needed now!
Good length ball on the off, Gayakwad punches it to the short cover. Dot.
Fuller one, around off. Rajeshwari Gayakwad plays it to covers and calls for one. A bit of miscommunication but the batters are safe.

OUT! CAUGHT! Richa walks out giving India Women a glimmer of hope. Fuller and on off, Richa gets on her knee and lofts it. The ball hits the upper part of her bat and carries towards long on and Aliya Riaz pouches it easily.
Commentary.Howout: c Aliya Riaz b Sadia Iqbal

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Six followed by a boundary! Richa Ghosh is putting on quite a show here! Tossed up, outside off, fuller ball. Richa Ghosh goes inside-out over cover for a boundary. 18 needed now for India Women!
SIX! BOOM! Richa Ghosh is keeping India Women's hopes alive! Shorter ball, around middle. Richa Ghosh swivels and pulls it high over long on for a biggie.

OUT! TAKEN! There is another twist in this game! Nashra Sandhu might have gone for two sixes in the over but she has fought back well and picked up a wicket here! A fuller ball, loopy one, around middle. Radha Yadav steps down the pitch and heaves this one wide of long on. The ball goes more off the inner half of the bat and fails to go all the way. Aliya Riaz runs to her right and takes another safe catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Aliya Riaz b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is played towards mid-wicket.
SIX! The game is on. Fuller and on off, Richa slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for another maximum!
SIX! MASSIVE! 100 up for India Women with this maximum. Full delivery, on off. Richa lofts it over long on for a biggie.
Dropped! Fuller again, around off. Yadav lofts it but doesn't connect well. The ball goes in the air towards long off. The fielder makes a good attempt diving forward. They cross.
Fuller one on off, this is played towards fine leg for one.
Floated delivery on the middle and leg. Ghosh sweeps it to the leg side and takes a single.
Tossed up on off, Radha Yadav drives it to covers. The fielder makes an amazing stop diving to her right. They cross.
Fuller and on off, this is played towards covers for one.
Fuller and on off, this is played towards long on for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Fuller and on off, Kaur moves forward and lofts it but doesn't get the power right. The ball goes in the air and Aliya Riaz takes a good catch at long off diving forward. India Women sink further and that should probably be the game for Pakistan Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Aliya Riaz b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on off, Kaur drills it to mid off. She denies for a single.
Make that four dots in a row! Tosses it up, full and around off. Richa Ghosh pushes it back to the bowler.
Third dot on the trot! Outside off, quick and short in length. Richa Ghosh misses her cut shot.
Another shorter ball, outside off. Richa Ghosh finds the fielder at point once again.
Outside off, shorter in length, Richa Ghosh cuts it towards point.

OUT! IN THE AIR...AND TAKEN! Another huge moment in the game! Deepti Sharma was looking threatening, but Pakistan have managed to get rid of her. A fuller ball, outside off. Deepti Sharma looks to scoop this one over short fine leg. But the ball goes off the top edge towards the fielder there. Bismah Maroof settles under it and takes a good catch. India Women need deep trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Bismah Maroof b Sadia Iqbal

Commentary.Commentary: Very full, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur works it away towards long on for a run.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Deepti Sharma! A pitched-up delivery, outside off. Deepti Sharma caresses this one through mid off for another four.
FOUR! Crunched! A short ball, around middle. Deepti Sharma stays in her crease and pulls it towards cow corner for a boundary.
In the air...and safe! A short ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it just over the fielder at square leg for a single.
A fuller ball, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans in and drives it through cover for a brace.
Angling in, around middle and leg. Deepti Sharma works it away towards square leg for another single.
Very short this time, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur uses the depth of her crease and pulls it over square leg for a single.
Outside off, very full this time. Harmanpreet Kaur squeezes it towards point for a single.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary! This should release some pressure! A fuller ball, around middle. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it wide of long on for a boundary.
Slower through the air, yorker now. outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur does well to dig this one out.
Loopy ball, around middle, fuller one, Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it out.
A low full toss, around middle, this is knocked down to long on for a single.
Very full, around middle, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and on middle, Deepti Sharma eases it to mid-wicket. Dot.
Tossed up on middle, this is defended back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Fuller and on leg, Deepti sweeps it past backward square leg for a boundary!
On off, this is palyed towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller and on off, Kaur eases it to point and gets off the mark.

OUT! BOWLED! Another one bites the dust. Pressure piling on India Women now. Tosses it on off, Hemalatha moves across to scoop it but misses as the ball rattles away the off pole. India Women are five down now!
Short and wide of off. Deepti Sharma slaps it towards deep cover for a brace.
Fuller ball, outside off. Deepti Sharma prods forward and pushes it towards cover. No run there!

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! Mix-up in the middle and India Women lose another wicket! They are throwing it away here. A fuller ball, around middle and off. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it back towards away from the bowler. Pooja Vastrakar leaves her crease after a lot of hesitation, but she is sent back halfway. Nashra Sandhu grabs the ball and throws it towards the keeper. Muneeba Ali collects the ball and removes the bails off. Pooja Vastrakar is nowhere near her crease.
Fuller ball, around middle. Dayalan Hemalatha works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller ball, outside off. Pooja Vastrakar pushes it towards mid off and takes a single.

A fuller ball, outside off, slower through the air. Pooja Vastrakar leans in and pushes it towards cover for a quick single. The throw is well away from the stumps at the bowler's end and the batters grab another run.
Fuller ball on the off, Pooja Vastrakar drives it through the covers for a single.
This one lands wide outside off, Pooja Vastrakar leaves it alone. Wided.
Fuller and on off, Dayalan Hemalatha looks to flick it but gets her pads towards the leg side. They cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Fuller and on off, Hemalatha flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary. Excellent shot!
Fuller one this time, Pooja eases it to covers fr a quick single. The fielder throws the ball back at the keeper nut the batter was well in.
Tossed up on off with some extra bounce, Pooja defends it to covers.
Good length ball on the middle stump line, Hemalatha works it away for a single.
On off, this is defended towards the on side.
Fuller and on off, this is eased towards the fielder at point.
Drinks! The game is on the edge and it is Pakistan Women who have their noses slightly in front. India Women will have to fight back and get back in the game. Pooja Vastrakar walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! Smriti Mandhana looks to go big but she holes out! Muneeba Ali can breathe a sigh of relief for now! Nashra Sandhu tosses this one up, serves it full, around middle and off. Smriti Mandhana shimmies down the pitch and lifts it towards long on. She gets more height than distance on that one and Aiman Anwer takes a lovely catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Aiman Anwer b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards cover.

MISSED STUMPING CHANCE! A huge moment in the game! A fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana dances down the pitch and looks to go over cover. But she manages to just an inside edge onto the pitch and towards the keeper. Muneeba Ali does well to stop the ball, but she fails to gather it and knock the stumps.
FOUR! Put away! Too short this time, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Quicker, darting it on the pads. Dayalan Hemalatha works it away towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Outside off, a fuller ball, Dayalan Hemalatha steps down and goes inside-out cover for a boundary.

Back of a length, outside off, spinning away. Dayalan Hemalatha looks to cut this one away but she misses. A loud shout for caught behind but the umpire says no. Pakistan do not seem very happy with that decision.
Shorter ball, outside off from 'round the wicket now. Smriti Mandhana knocks it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
A leg-break, short, around middle. Dayalan Hemalatha tucks it towards square leg for a single.
A fuller ball, outside off, a loopy one. Dayalan Hemalatha leans in and pushes it towards cover.
Fuller and down the middle, Hemalatha flicks it towards square leg for one.
On off, defended out.
Fuller and down the leg side, Hemalatha helps it towards fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! Fuller and on middle, Hemalatha dances down the track and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Bowls it outside off, Hemalatha looks to play at it but misses.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Mandhana taps it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Yorker one and on middle, Mandhana digs it to long off for one.
Goes fuller this time, Hemalatha drives it towards covers for one.
Length and on off, Hemalatha pulls it but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Slower one outside off, Hemalatha taps it towards the fielder at point.
Another one outside off, Hemalatha looks to play at it but misses again.
On a length and outside off, Hemalatha looks to drive it but misses.
Fuller one and around off. drives it towards the cover fielder.
Slightly shorter and on off, this is punched towards mid on. Dot.
Tossed up, on off, this is flicked towards square leg for one.
Full on the off, Hemalatha prods forward and defends it.

OUT! TAKEN! Pakistan Women finally get the dangerous Jemimah Rodrigues. Fuller and on off, Jemimah Rodrigues moves forward and looks to loft it but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air towards point and Tuba Hassan takes an easy catch. India Women are two down inside the Powerplay.
Commentary.Howout: c Tuba Hassan b Nida Dar

Commentary.Commentary: Another drop! Jemimah Rodrigues is living life at the edge! Tossed up, on off. Jemimah Rodrigues pulls it hard towards square leg. The fielder does well to get there but once again fails to pouch the ball. Dot.
Another pitched-up delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it off the front foot towards mid off. No run there!
Short one now, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues pushes it towards cover for a single.

DROPPED! A chance goes begging and Jemimah Rodrigues gets a life! A fuller ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues sweeps this one towards mid on. The fielder there, dives to her left, gets to the ball but fails to grab it.
Fuller ball, around middle and off. Jemimah Rodrigues prods forward and pushes it towards cover.
Another lovely drive, but not in the gap! Fuller ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues once again strides forward and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Pitched-up delivery, around off. Jemimah Rodrigues prods forward and drives it firmly towards the fielder at cover.
Outside off, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and guides it towards backward point with an open-faced bat. A dot to end then.
FOUR! Oh, shot! A low full toss, around off. Smriti Mandhana skips down the pitch and creams her drive through cover for a lovely boundary.
Tossed up on off, Smriti Mandhana taps it to point. Dot.
A fuller ball, outside off. Jemimah Rodrigues leans in and drives it through mid off for a single. She gets off the mark!
Jemimah Rodrigues is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Nashra Sandhu strikes in her first over! She gets rid of the dangerous, Sabbhineni Meghana! A fuller ball, slower through the air, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana steps down the pitch and goes inside-out but fails to clear the infield. Sidra Ameen at cover runs backwards and takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sidra Ameen b Nashra Sandhu

Commentary.Commentary: A shorter one, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana cuts it to the fielder at point.
A fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards cover. No run there!
Wide! Bowls it wide outside off, Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Fuller and on off, this is flicked towards midwicket for one.
Wide! This one lands outside leg, Sabbhineni Meghana lets it go.
On a length and on off, Sabbhineni Meghana eases it towards the off side.
Fuller one on middle, this is defended solidly.
FOUR! Excellent timing! Fuller one tad outside off, Meghana makes room and lofts it over the extra cover for a boundary.
Good length on off, Mandhana punches it to the short cover for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Nida Dar pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Tosses this one up, full and outside off. Smriti Mandhana goes inside-out over cover for a brace.
Fuller and outside off, Smriti Mandhana drives it but finds the fielder at covers.
Outside off, fuller in length, Sabbhineni Meghana leans in and drives it through cover for a single.
SIX! Up and away! Lovely shot! A fuller ball, around middle. Sabbhineni Meghana steps down the pitch and tonks it straight down the ground for a biggie.
A fuller ball, around middle. Sabbhineni Meghana pushes it towards cover off the front foot.
Outside off, a shorter ball. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and guides it past point for a brace.
A fuller ball, outside off. Sabbhineni Meghana chips it away from the fielder at mid off. A single taken!
A fuller ball, around middle and leg. Sabbhineni Meghana steps down the pitch and drags it with the inner half of her bat through square leg for a brace.
Shorter ball, around middle and off. Sabbhineni Meghana rocks back and blocks it out.
This one comes in with the arm, down the leg side. Sabbhineni Meghana makes room and looks to go cover but she misses and gets hit on her thigh pad. An appeal there for LBW, but it's turned down.
Sadia Iqbal begins with a fuller ball, loopy one as well, around middle and off, Sabbhineni Meghana leans forward and blocks it out.
